# CompareLab — GitHub repository metadata

These values are **suggested repository About settings**, not automatic changes to GitHub's About panel. Editing this file does not update repository settings.

## Description

Compare AI model outputs and prompt variants in VS Code with Git-style diffs, evaluation checks, and local Ollama/OpenAI-compatible runners.

## Homepage

No separate product website for v0.2. Keep the repository URL as the primary entry point; do not invent a documentation homepage.

## Discoverability notes

- Use **VS Code** and **AI model comparison** in the description: they explain both the surface and intent.
- Mention **Ollama/OpenAI-compatible** because both runners are present in v0.2.
- Do not advertise a marketplace listing, automatic semantic grading, multi-model leaderboard, CI gate, or hosted SaaS until those features ship.
- To apply: open [repository settings](https://github.com/Azayzel/CompareLab), click the **About** edit control, and set the description/topics. This integration currently cannot modify those specific GitHub settings directly.
